description: 228-vertex unit-distance graph on the sphere S^2(r), r^2 = (5+sqrt5)/8 (circumradius of the unit-edge icosahedron); edges = ALL pairs at Euclidean chord exactly 1 (faithful). Chromatic number 5 (certified: not 4-colorable [CNF + DRAT], every vertex deletion 4-colorable [colorings]).

field.tower: F0 = Q; F1 = Q(w1), w1^2 = d1; F2 = F1(w2), w2^2 = d2 in F1; F3 = F2(w3), w3^2 = d3 in F2. An element of F_k is written [a, b] meaning a + b*w_k with a, b in F_{k-1}; elements of Q are 'p/q' strings. So a coordinate [[[c000,c001],[c010,c011]],[[c100,c101],[c110,c111]]] means sum c_{ijk} w3^i w2^j w1^k. [F3:Q] = 8.
field.real_embedding: w1 = +sqrt(5), w2 = +sqrt(d2), w3 = +sqrt(d3) (all d_k > 0 in this embedding)

construction.summary: 12 vertices of the unit-edge icosahedron (0, +-1/2, +-phi/2) and cyclic permutations, plus a copy rotated about the axis through the centre of face (0,2,8) by theta with cos(theta) = (3 sqrt5 - 5)/4 (~64.72 deg); closure under circle intersection (new point at chord 1 from two existing points), exact-window local search and local augmentation; this vertex set is the result.
